sample_unit: question evaluations (250 questions x 2 languages x 3 models)

links.outcome: Benchmark exam-style accuracy of GPT models on neurosurgery multiple-choice questions
links.effect: GPT-5.0 78.0% combined accuracy vs GPT-3.5 61.8% and GPT-4.0 60.8%; overall accuracy remains below 80%, and authors note limited clinical applicability.
links.quote: However, overall accuracy remains below 80%, and the absence of human benchmarking and the single-trial design limit direct clinical applicability.

unlisted_practices: Self-correction prompting after an incorrect answer (revision prompt) to improve LLM accuracy

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance (GPT models) and self-correction capability on a multiple-choice neurosurgery question bank without evaluating real-world clinical deployment safeguards or organizational practices.
